Description

Located on one of London’s most prestigious and highly desirable garden squares, this three-bedroom maisonette offers a wealth of elegance. The property is a first and second floor duplex in a stucco fronted period building, boasting classic high ceilings featuring traditional cornicing and natural light. The first floor offers a large entertaining space with a double reception room leading to a private south facing balcony looking onto the gardens. The dining room offers a central staircase gracefully leading to the second floor with three well-proportioned bedrooms. The opulent principle en-suite offers direct views of the gardens. Quintessentially located on this prestigious and highly sought-after square in
Belgravia, this superb property boasts luxurious living.

Eaton Square is a highly regarded address located in the heart of Belgravia, 0.5 miles from Sloane Square underground station. The shops of Elizabeth Street are close by, together with all the many international shops and amenities of Knightsbridge.
